name: Manazuru Kazuha
source:
Hobbies: Sewing (making stuffed toys)
Skills: Fencing
Weakness: Ghosts, insects

A first-year and the secretary of the east tower's student council. She is actually [url=/c40212]Honoka's[/url] childhood friend and both of them consider each other their best friend. Kazuha controls wind magic, but has also the best sword skills in the academy.

A modern samurai-like girl with a refined appearance and personality. She is also relaxed and very friendly. Alongside her hobby of making stuffed toys, she loves giving cute names.
